programme.title: Could Notre Dame MISS The CFP? Championship Weekend Preview | Others Receiving Votes
programme.desc: Sports Illustrated's Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined by former longtime College Gameday reporter Gene Wojciechowski to break down Championship weekend, the CFP race and more. On this episode of Other's Receiving Votes, the crew give their takes on the latest CFP Rankings, including the debate about Notre Dame and Miami. They mention who got the biggest boost and put in the biggest trouble this week and the give their top 12 teams overall heading into the final week of play before the playoffs are locked. Following that, they take a look at the crazy coaching carousel, starting with the situation on Penn State as they continue to look for a new head coach to replace James Franklin. They also discuss the latest on the Lane Kiffin situation and whether the now former Ole Miss coach should have been able to coach his team in the playoffs, even after he announced his decision to leave for LSU next year. They finish things up with their Commenters Commenting on Comments segment presented by Facebook, answering questions found in Facebook Fan Groups about the latest in college football. They break down some of the big stories from National Signing Day. And, finally, they give their picks for Championship Weekend, including the Big Ten Championship Game between Ohio State and Indiana, the SEC Championship Game between Alabama and Georgia and a couple of games with MAJOR playoff implications in the ACC and American Conference Championship Games.
